description: We are Ecos del Humboldt, 4 students from Lima: 3 Environmental Engineering and 1 Fisheries Engineering. For The Earth Information Jukebox we will turn NASA ocean data (sea temperature, chlorophyll, El Niño) from the Peruvian coast into sound, so fishers and visually impaired people can "hear" the sea change. We bring Earth science, ocean and fisheries knowledge. Looking for: coding/web development, audio or music production, and video editing. ¡Hablamos español!
